name: [CONSOLE🎮] East Croydon 🔪
desc:
East Croydon drops you into the gritty, unforgiving streets where only the strongest survive. In this hood-themed Roblox game based in East Croydon,, London,  it’s all about respect, money, and power. Hustle your way to the top by robbing NPCs, pulling off daring heists, and battling rival players for control of the block. 
We do not condone random killing. If you random kill, you will be banned.

🚨 PRIVATE SERVERS ENABLED FOR SOLO PLAYERS / PLAYERS LOOKING TO GRIND
